revision_note: Work packages K01-K09 from PRD v0.2 section 11.3. K01 has three implemented increments: the aarch64 NEON fused packed dot for Q8_0/F16 with zero-copy mapped weight blocks (CPU, validated against scalar references and the llama.cpp envelope), the first Metal increment from Gate C C0/C1 (device/queue owner, typed resource handles with allocation accounting, grouped dispatch, packed Q8_0 GEMV and F16/F32 utilities), and the C2 increment: the complete dense-Qwen3 decode (RMSNorm, Q/K norm, NeoX RoPE, GQA attention with f16-contract KV, SwiGLU, residuals, final projection) executed on the GPU through crates/metal, validated against the CPU scalar oracle on the pinned Qwen3-0.6B artifact (teacher-forced logits max |diff| 4.7e-5 over scale 16.6, identical top-1 and greedy output). K03 and K08 grow their Metal increments accordingly. A kernel must never be selected before its correctness gate passes; every selection retains a validated reference fallback decision. Fast microbatched prefill remains unbuilt (C3).
